title: Get Started with Teal - Live Webinar - November 6th
description:
Now is the perfect time to take charge of your job search. 
Whether it's crafting the perfect resume, tracking your applications, or beating that pesky Applicant Tracking System (ATS), we've got you covered this winter. 

Join us for a new series 'Get Started with Teal,' where we'll guide you through getting set up with the Teal Resume Builder and Job Tracker and share valuable job search tips. 

This session was hosted by Teal Recruiter and Social Media Manager, Leah Dillon, and Community and Support Specialist, Emily Woodward.

Whether it's building your resume, searching for the right job, or marketing yourself for the role you want, we've got you covered with tools like our FREE Chrome Extension, Job Tracker, and Resume Builder. Head over to www.tealhq.com to get started on your AI-powered resume.

These webinars will share similar information and tips every week, so if you're unable to join live, watch past episodes here on YouTube!

Tune into the next webinar LIVE: https://lu.ma/018386xr

Need a little boost to help your job search? Now is the perfect time to get ahead of the 2024 season. Read more here: https://www.tealhq.com/post/best-time-to-apply-for-jobs
